why_it_matters: Validation targets are plausibility anchors and cannot become live constraints by default
required_evidence_or_check: Check that constraint usage stays blocked in the packet
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms the row remains a validation-only anchor
fail_or_defer_condition: If a validation target is proposed as a process bound production target or inventory constraint then fail
notes: This is a hard separation rule.

criterion: Annual anchors remain non-hourly without explicit translation approval
why_it_matters: Annual public anchors can be misread as hourly truth
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states whether the row is annual-only and whether translation is blocked
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms annual anchor status stays non-hourly unless separately approved
fail_or_defer_condition: If an annual anchor is treated as an hourly cap without explicit approval then fail
notes: This rule applies even if the anchor is widely cited publicly.

why_it_matters: Validation anchors can still be useful for diagnostics and reconciliation
required_evidence_or_check: Check that the packet labels reporting or plausibility use clearly
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms reporting-only use is explicit
fail_or_defer_condition: If the row mixes reporting use with executable parameter use then defer
notes: Validation targets may support checks without becoming executable.
